requirements.title: Support passkeys, primary Google sign-in and password fallback

sourceText.text: Provide Google SSO as the main sign-in provider, passkeys, and email-or-username/password fallback for both staff and approved vehicle owners. Normalise supported email/username identifiers consistently, keep passwords securely hashed, rate-limit authentication and recovery, prevent enumeration and enforce session revocation and CSRF controls. requirements.title: Use one typed service-request intake for repairs, PSAI and Service Centre PDI

sourceText.text: Management guidance: customers and third parties request repair/maintenance, Post Shipping Acceptance Inspection (PSAI), or Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) through one Service Request page. Staff can record requests for clients. Service Advisors review requests and convert accepted, confirmed arrivals into linked work orders for workshop fulfilment. Service Centre PSAI and PDI are fee-bearing regardless of who requests them; a PDI may be for showroom stock or a partner garage. If a vehicle already has a service record, authorized clients should be able to enter identifying details and see the vehicle context they are allowed to access; staff can privately match third-party reported details during review.

The service centre receives PSAI and PDI requests from third parties and charges a fee regardless of which third party requests the inspection. PSAI means Post Shipping Acceptance Inspection. PDI means Pre-Delivery Inspection and may be for a vehicle coming from showroom stock or a partner garage for a customer. For a vehicle already in the service database, an authorized client may enter identifying details during the request and see the vehicle information that account is allowed to access. Service Advisors take requests from the backend and process accepted, arrived vehicles into workshop work orders.

acceptance: Provide one intake for client, third-party and staff-on-behalf requests for repair/maintenance, PSAI and Service Centre PDI.
Keep requester, payer/client, reported owner, visit contact, vehicle, vehicle source and recorder distinct; preserve unverified values as reported claims.

Allow an authenticated client to find and prefill only vehicles already authorized to that account; third-party and anonymous requests must not reveal whether an identifier matches another client's record.
Record a reported showroom/partner-garage source for Service Centre PDI, or a shipping reference for PSAI when supplied, and carry that context into the work order without treating it as verified.

Do not reveal whether a submitted VIN/chassis/registration matches another customer or expose that vehicle/history to an unverified requester; authenticated clients may see only vehicles already authorized to their account.

Let the Service Advisor review, request missing information, confirm exact same-site canonical client/vehicle where permitted, and convert a confirmed arrival exactly once to one linked, typed work order for Operations review.
Keep external Service Centre PDI as a workshop work order distinct from internal Sales delivery-preparation PDI and Sales delivery history.

Require a configured inspection fee for every PSAI and Service Centre PDI regardless of requester or staff-entry path; invoice the explicitly confirmed paying client. Do not issue a quote/invoice or pass commercial handover while the applicable rate/authority is unconfigured.

Keep PSAI and Service Centre PDI checklist/report templates distinct from repair and routine maintenance, and keep technical activation blocked until exact vehicle source/revision, scope, evidence and review authority are effective.
Preserve site isolation, version checks, idempotency, actor audit, append-only correction history, privacy, accessibility, responsive behavior and callback history.

existingEvidence.note: Staff request/callback now stores four typed service kinds. Reported PDI source and PSAI shipping reference can flow through Advisor reception into a work order and standard report. Focused API/PostgreSQL and browser verification cover this staff path. Customer/third-party submission, verified matching, dedicated inspection templates and price configuration remain unfinished. No public vehicle lookup is exposed.
